items.evidence: Financial measures are key indicators of our profitable growth and are aligned with our external operating framework
For purposes of the Gratitude Bonus Plan, "Revenue" is defined as our GAAP revenues
"Operating Cash Flow" is defined as our GAAP operating cash flow.
"Non-GAAP Income from Operations" is defined as our non-GAAP income from operations
ESG measures strategically aligned with existing equality and net zero public commitments and initiatives
The equality measures focus on increasing representation of women, Black, Latinx, Indigenous and Multiracial employees.
The sustainability measures focus on reducing global air travel emissions intensity
Air travel emissions intensity is the amount of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions attributed to air travel
The Sustainability Exhibit is the set of sustainability-related terms that Salesforce aims to include in supplier contracts.
as well as the NEO's individual performance for the year
Payouts tied to our three-year TSR performance relative to the Nasdaq
